physical_independence: All real images used for training. No target test set is reserved.
visual_review: Each sequence first/middle/last representatives inspected across all 12 classes, not exhaustive per-frame review.
label_authority: User-provided food folders checked against sequence representative images; stale JSON candidate_class_key_unreviewed ignored.
capture_information: User confirms the supplied images are not consecutive frames.
training_strategy: Shuffle each training image once per epoch; no replacement sampler.
selection: food_verify validation only; test is a previously exposed comparison benchmark.
